scenarios.expected_result: TLS 1.3 channel established and the token accepted; no media starts before authentication.
scenarios.observed_result: TLS 1.3 channel established in 119 ms; the single-use token was accepted and consumed.
scenarios.preconditions: Fresh desktop session; QR displayed; mobile scans raw bytes and pins the leaf SHA-256.

scenarios.expected_result: The TLS handshake aborts with certificate_pin_mismatch before any media.
scenarios.observed_result: TLS aborted on the pinned fingerprint; the pairing token was never sent.
scenarios.preconditions: The mobile is configured with a fingerprint that differs from the leaf in one byte.

scenarios.expected_result: The attempt is rejected as chain-only trust, with no fallback to CA validation.
scenarios.observed_result: the presented chain was valid under the supplied root but the leaf was not the pinned certificate.
scenarios.preconditions: The presented leaf chains to a CA the client knows, but is not the pinned leaf.

scenarios.expected_result: The handshake is refused as a downgrade attempt.
scenarios.observed_result: the TLS 1.2 ClientHello was refused; no downgrade path exists.
scenarios.preconditions: The client offers TLS 1.2; the listener is TLS 1.3 only.

scenarios.expected_result: The listener rejects the token as expired.
scenarios.observed_result: the correct token was presented after its window closed and was refused.
scenarios.preconditions: The correct token is presented after its 120-second window closed.

scenarios.expected_result: The replay is rejected; the previous pairing is not reusable.
scenarios.observed_result: the first pairing consumed the token; the replay against a restarted listener was refused.
scenarios.preconditions: A token that already paired once is replayed against a restarted listener with the same store.

scenarios.observed_result: the forged token did not match and was refused.
scenarios.preconditions: The mobile presents a forged 256-bit token.

scenarios.expected_result: The listener refuses the source before the TLS handshake.
scenarios.observed_result: the listener dropped the connection before the TLS handshake because the source was not private.
scenarios.preconditions: The connection arrives from an address outside the permitted private ranges.

scenarios.expected_result: The client aborts on the pin before sending the pairing token.
scenarios.observed_result: the client aborted on the pin before sending the pairing token to the proxy.
scenarios.preconditions: A proxy terminates TLS with its own certificate and answers the paired message.

scenarios.expected_result: The payload is refused at decode time.
scenarios.observed_result: the payload failed validation before any socket was opened.
scenarios.preconditions: The scanned payload carries an expiry equal to the current time.

scenarios.expected_result: The payload is refused at decode time.
scenarios.observed_result: the payload failed validation before any socket was opened.
scenarios.preconditions: The scanned bytes are shorter than the fixed header and carry no magic.

scenarios.expected_result: The payload is refused at decode time; no QR is displayable.
scenarios.observed_result: the payload failed validation before any socket was opened.
scenarios.preconditions: The payload advertises a public address as its only endpoint.

scenarios.expected_result: The session aborts before any media starts.
scenarios.observed_result: the token was accepted but the media fingerprint was tampered with, so the session aborted before media.
scenarios.preconditions: The token is correct but the DTLS fingerprint differs from the value the listener expects.
